name: Koi to xx no Femdom
source:
“I want to know… the truth behind this intuition.”

The protagonist, a teacher, is suddenly confessed to by one of his female students one evening. Her name is Shiozuki Manami—the student council president, a top-performing student, and a beautiful girl.
Though he initially rejects her confession, a chance encounter leads to a kiss, and the two begin a secret relationship.
“We won’t cross the final line until after graduation.”
They make this promise for the sake of their futures, but ironically, it’s this very restriction that awakens a lewd desire within Manami. As her desires grow, what conclusion will she reach…?

A M-themed ADV where a talented and beautiful girl gradually transforms into a seductive dominatrix!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ205076.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
“我想知道……这个直觉背后的真相。”

主人公是一位老师，一天晚上突然被一名女学生告白。她的名字叫盐月真奈美，学生会长，成绩优秀的学生，美丽的少女。
尽管他最初拒绝了她的表白，但一次偶然的相遇导致了接吻，两人开始了秘密关系。
“毕业之前我们不会跨过最后的线。”
他们为了自己的未来而做出这样的承诺，但讽刺的是，正是这种限制唤醒了真奈美内心的淫荡欲望。随着她的欲望越来越大，她会得出什么结论……？

一个M主题的ADV，一个才华横溢的美丽女孩逐渐变成一个诱人的施虐狂！
